summary: Intermap Technologies filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 21, 2026 press release announcing a three-year subscription agreement with Colonnade Insurance S.A., a Luxembourg non-life insurer owned by Fairfax Financial Holdings. The integrated flood risk and property valuation solution begins in the Czech Republic with planned expansion across markets. No price, stake, premium, or closing terms were disclosed; no board recommendation or advisor was named. This is an ordinary commercial contract disclosure, not a special situation, with no risk-arb angle.
